publishedDeadlines.label: Annual rolling PhD application period
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated annual period for the following fall; not a confirmed Fall 2027 date.

applicationFee.note: International-applicant section explicitly calls fee waivable; criteria and approval process not stated. Confirm approval before payment.

english.note: TOEFL/IELTS required when English is not the first language and the applicant has no degree from a US college/university. Numerical minimum not stated.

documents: Official transcripts from all college/university courses and institutions
requirements.note: Bachelor degree or equivalent required; no specific GPA minimum. International applicants need documentation of financial support for living in the US. Program curriculum includes laboratory rotations.

funding.note: Trustee Tuition Scholarships available to all full-time matriculated basic-science doctoral/graduate students. Stipend,insurance and universal award guarantee not established.

timeline.interviews: Virtual interview required. In-person interviews may be requested subject to availability; applicant bears costs.
